Message.Name: Logon Message
Message.Description: Enables client authentication. Not required for multicast channels and only used for retransmission requests. The client sends a Logon containing a username, to which LMEsource responds with a Logon Response.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username to log on, padded with binary null characters.

Message.Name: Logon Response Message
Message.Description: Response to a Logon, carrying the status of the session.

Message.Name: Retransmission Request Message
Message.Description: Requests the retransmission of a range of messages on a multicast channel.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: Multicast Channel ID to which the retransmission relates.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the last message in the range to be resent.

Message.Name: Retransmission Response Message
Message.Description: Response to a Retransmission Request, carrying the status of the request and the sequence range being resent.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: Multicast Channel ID to which the retransmission relates.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNum
Field.Description: First sequence number of the Retransmission. Only populated when RetransStatus is 0.

Field.Name: EndSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number of the Retransmission. Only populated when RetransStatus is 0.
